capabilities: Render a contact card from frontmatter in reading mode
Browse all contacts in a searchable, filterable sidebar panel
Add a contacts card view to .base files with sorting, grouping, and filtering
Create new contacts from a frontmatter template with enforced First Middle Last file naming
Support multiple emails, phone numbers, and social media profiles per contact
disambiguation: Not an address-book sync or import tool; it only renders and browses contact notes that already exist in the vault.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README points to a separate ROADMAP.md for planned features and includes BRAT as an alternative installation path.
intentEvidence: Render the same contact cards inside an Obsidian .base file
problem: Obsidian stores contact details as plain frontmatter with no built-in way to render them as cards or browse all contacts in one place.

relations.evidence: surface them through an Obsidian Bases view

summary: Contact card renderer that turns notes with contact frontmatter into visual cards, browsable in a sidebar panel or an Obsidian Bases view.
